domain_symbols.programming: formal laws governing programming language semantics and safety
domain_symbols.symbolic: symbolic expressions used by this domain

rules.name: Referential transparency
rules.input_form: pure expression e with no side effects
rules.output_form: e evaluates to same value in all contexts with same bindings
preconditions: No mutable global state read during evaluation
rules.operation: Substitute equals for equals without changing program meaning.
counterexamples: rand(), time(), unchecked IO in pure context
common_errors: Caching impure calls as if pure

rules.name: Rust ownership move semantics
rules.input_form: value v of owned type T moved to binding x
rules.output_form: previous owner of v becomes invalid; exactly one live owner
preconditions: No Copy trait unless bitwise duplicate is safe
rules.operation: Enforce single-owner memory discipline at compile time.

rules.name: Python LEGB name resolution
rules.input_form: identifier x referenced in nested scope
rules.output_form: resolve Local -> Enclosing -> Global -> Builtins
preconditions: Standard CPython execution model
rules.operation: Resolve free variables by static nesting chain.
counterexamples: Unqualified assignment creates local without global decl

rules.name: JavaScript prototype chain lookup
rules.input_form: property access obj.p
rules.output_form: walk [[Prototype]] until p found or null
preconditions: Ordinary object internal methods
rules.operation: Delegate property resolution along prototype links.

rules.name: Go goroutine CSP concurrency
rules.input_form: go f(); channel ch with typed sends/receives
rules.output_form: independent lightweight thread + synchronized message passing
preconditions: Scheduler multiplexes goroutines onto OS threads
rules.operation: Share memory by communicating, not communicate by sharing.
counterexamples: Unsynchronized map writes across goroutines race

rules.name: C undefined behavior boundary
rules.input_form: operation outside ISO C standard guarantees
rules.output_form: compiler may assume UB never happens; any behavior permitted
preconditions: No sanitizers catching violation at runtime
rules.operation: Treat UB as non-existence for optimization.

rules.name: Zig comptime evaluation
rules.input_form: expression marked comptime or known at compile time
rules.output_form: evaluated during compilation; result embedded in binary
preconditions: All inputs to comptime block are compile-time known
rules.operation: Execute subset of language at compile time for zero-cost generics.

rules.name: WebAssembly structured control flow
rules.input_form: block, loop, if with result type
rules.output_form: stack-polymorphic validation; branches only to enclosing constructs
preconditions: Valid module type-checked before instantiation
rules.operation: Guarantee verifiable sandboxed execution without arbitrary goto.
counterexamples: Unstructured branch to arbitrary label rejected
common_errors: Stack type mismatch at block end

rules.name: Lean dependent type checking
rules.input_form: term t : A where A may depend on values
rules.output_form: definitional + propositional equality checked by kernel
preconditions: Kernel accepts only certified proof terms
rules.operation: Reject ill-typed programs before they enter trusted corpus.

rules.name: Halting problem undecidability
rules.input_form: program P and input x
rules.output_form: no general algorithm decides if P halts on x
preconditions: Turing-complete language
rules.operation: Limits total automatic verification; motivates conservative analysis.
counterexamples: Total languages on bounded domains may decide
common_errors: Claiming 100% zero-day detection for all programs

rules.name: Type soundness preservation
rules.input_form: well-typed program state (e, sigma)
rules.output_form: evaluation step preserves typing; progress or stuck on value
preconditions: Standard small-step operational semantics
rules.operation: Well-typed programs do not go wrong (Milner).

rules.name: FSOTB trinary opcode totality on finite tape
rules.input_form: FSOTB program with bounded register file
rules.output_form: each opcode maps register state to successor within 27-trit word
preconditions: ABI tier v1_0..v1_2 respected
rules.operation: Deterministic scalar evolution on trinary hardware motif.
common_errors: Mixing ABI tiers without version gate

rules.name: Code-genome codon stability hole
rules.input_form: 3-codon window W with mean stability < 0.85
rules.output_form: connective_failure hole flagged; risk tier elevated
preconditions: 64-codon unified alphabet mapping
rules.operation: Detect structural illness analog in program token layout.
common_errors: Treating hole detection error as misprediction

rules.name: Immutability default in functional cores
rules.input_form: binding let x = v
rules.output_form: x cannot be reassigned; new binding shadows in inner scope
preconditions: Language without mutable let by default
rules.operation: Reduce aliasing bugs via single-assignment discipline.

rules.name: Capability security object-cap model
rules.input_form: unforgeable capability token cap
rules.output_form: holder of cap may invoke operation; no ambient authority
preconditions: No global root privilege without explicit cap
rules.operation: Confine authority to least-privilege handles.
counterexamples: setuid root binaries with broad filesystem access
common_errors: Passing raw file paths instead of sealed handles

rules.name: Small-step operational semantics
rules.input_form: configuration (e, sigma) and reduction relation e -> e'
rules.output_form: single evaluation step to successor configuration
preconditions: Deterministic or labeled transition system defined
rules.operation: Define meaning via step-by-step state evolution.

rules.name: Big-step natural semantics
rules.input_form: expression e and store sigma
rules.output_form: value v such that e, sigma => v
preconditions: Compositionality of inference rules
rules.operation: Relate whole computations to final outcomes in one judgment.

rules.name: Hindley-Milner type inference
rules.input_form: unannotated term t in let-polymorphic calculus
rules.output_form: principal type scheme forall alpha. A with most general unifier
preconditions: Algorithm W or constraint generation + solving
rules.operation: Infer types without full annotations; generalize let-bindings.

rules.name: Parametric polymorphism erasure
rules.input_form: generic function id[T](x:T):T
rules.output_form: runtime representation independent of type parameter
preconditions: Type erasure or monomorphization policy declared
rules.operation: Type parameters guide static checking; runtime obeys erasure model.
common_errors: Assuming runtime type tests on erased params

rules.name: Algebraic data type introduction and elimination
rules.input_form: constructor C : A -> T and pattern match on T
rules.output_form: well-typed fold respecting constructor invariants
preconditions: Exhaustive, non-overlapping patterns
rules.operation: Introduce values via constructors; eliminate via case analysis.

rules.name: Monad laws
rules.input_form: monad (M, return, bind)
rules.output_form: left identity, right identity, associativity hold
preconditions: bind : M a -> (a -> M b) -> M b
rules.operation: Structure sequential effects without breaking equational reasoning.
counterexamples: Broken bind that drops errors silently

rules.name: Algebraic effect handlers
rules.input_form: computation performing effect operations op_i
rules.output_form: handler interprets ops; delimited continuation resumes
preconditions: Effect signatures scoped lexically
rules.operation: Separate effect declarations from handler implementations.
counterexamples: Global unchecked exceptions as implicit effects

rules.name: Linear type resource consumption
rules.input_form: binding x : A in linear context
rules.output_form: x used exactly once along any execution path
preconditions: Substructural typing rules enforced
rules.operation: Track physical/logical resources to prevent duplication and drop.

rules.name: Subtyping width and depth
rules.input_form: record type S <: T under width rule
rules.output_form: S has at least fields of T with compatible types
preconditions: Structural subtyping or nominal hierarchy declared
rules.operation: Allow safe coercions where information can be forgotten.

rules.name: Gradual typing consistency
rules.input_form: mixed static and dynamic typed regions
rules.output_form: blame assignment on boundary cast failure
preconditions: Consistency relation between static and dynamic semantics
rules.operation: Preserve sound gradual guarantees via casts and blame tracking.
common_errors: Assuming gradual implies full static soundness

rules.name: Denotational compositionality
rules.input_form: syntax category C with compositional denotation [[-]]
rules.output_form: [[c]] built from subphrase denotations only
preconditions: Semantic domain complete for constructs
rules.operation: Define program meaning in mathematical domain by structural recursion.

rules.name: Continuation-passing style transformation
rules.input_form: direct-style term t
rules.output_form: CPS term t' accepting continuation k
preconditions: Administrative normal form for call sites
rules.operation: Make control flow explicit as first-class continuations.
counterexamples: CPS transform without eta-expansion at call
common_errors: Mixing direct and CPS fragments unsoundly

rules.name: Java JVM stack type discipline
rules.input_form: bytecode method with operand stack and locals
rules.output_form: verifier proves stack kinds consistent at each instruction
preconditions: Classfile passes bytecode verification
rules.operation: Enforce memory-safe execution before JIT without source types.
counterexamples: Malformed stack depth at branch merge
common_errors: Assuming verifier catches all logic bugs

rules.name: Kotlin null-safety flow typing
rules.input_form: type T? and smart-cast after null check
rules.output_form: narrowed non-null T in dominated branch
preconditions: Stable smart-cast property or explicit safe-call
rules.operation: Eliminate NPE at compile time via flow-sensitive typing.
counterexamples: Platform type from Java without annotation

rules.name: Haskell lazy evaluation thunk sharing
rules.input_form: suspension thunk e in weak-head-normal form context
rules.output_form: evaluate to WHNF once; share result in memory
preconditions: Call-by-need semantics with update-in-place
rules.operation: Delay work until demanded; memoize computed values.
counterexamples: Space leak from retained thunk chain
